item.title: Functional Requirements
item.description: JoinSheets began as the user-facing layer on top of a larger project – a separate engine for versioned, historized storage of data pulled in from disparate sources (ds). That lower layer deliberately stayed out of semantics and UI; everything about actually looking at, combining, and exporting the data lived one layer up. Over time that upstream layer grew its own complete logic and split off into its own standalone product, with its own self-contained scope – JoinSheets.

item.title: Testing
item.description:
This page describes the project’s testing approach, the main kinds of tests, and the tools behind them. Before opening a pull request, make sure your change didn’t break anything.

JoinSheets has no automated CI – the full suite is run by hand before each release ships. Running it yourself before opening a pull request is good practice too: it’s the minimum protection against a sudden break during a merge, or an implicit conflict nobody noticed.

item.title: Releases
item.description:
This section describes the core principles behind JoinSheets’ release policy and the workflow for shipping a new release.

Development phase

The project is currently in beta: the core functionality is settled, and work now is about polishing individual pieces based on what early users run into.

During alpha, changes landed fast and somewhat chaotically, as new ideas or different ways to implement a feature came up, and releases were spontaneous – driven by how fast development was moving and how much had changed.

item.title: Contributing
item.description:
JoinSheets is under active development, and any engagement is genuinely appreciated – an issue, a pull request, feedback on any platform, even a star on GitHub.

For users

The team is actively working on usability and the interface, and tries to base changes on real user experience. The best contribution from a user is an issue: report a problem, or suggest a usability improvement. Include the app’s version – open the gear icon in the app’s main window (Settings) and check About.
